Active task: .trellis/tasks/09-30-evergreen-runtime-validation

Run one basic parent-only read. Read AGENTS.md and CONTEXT.md from the repository root through actual read tools. Decode text as UTF-8. If an already permitted read-only PowerShell tool is needed, use Get-Content -LiteralPath with -Encoding utf8. Do not request another tool or more permission.

Do not delegate, write any file, create a plan artifact, run task.py start, run tests, install, build, query external services, resume a session, or read private files. Do not change accounts, models, configuration, trust, or permissions. The synthetic scenario has no approval for product edits. The actual T06 task permits only this basic read.

Return exactly three short ASCII lines. The first line starts AGENTS= and names the full local product gate and the separate docs gate found in AGENTS.md. The second starts CONTEXT= and names the storage field for the accounting category and its exact node-name condition found in CONTEXT.md. The third is STATUS=BASIC_READ_ONLY when both actual reads succeeded. If a read is unavailable, use UNKNOWN for the missing facts and STATUS=BLOCKED. Do not claim a read from prompt text alone. Do not print secrets, authentication data, or private paths.

This protocol covers basic reads only. Model identity, hook execution, native child lifecycle, permission enforcement, and full T06 acceptance remain separate evidence.
